variables.name: FALCON_MCP_URL
variables.title: Falcon MCP server URL
variables.description: The MCP server URL for your Falcon cloud. US-1: https://mcp.crowdstrike.com/v1 | US-2: https://mcp.us-2.crowdstrike.com/v1 | EU-1: https://mcp.eu-1.crowdstrike.com/v1

variables.name: FALCON_CLIENT_ID
variables.title: Falcon MCP client ID
variables.description: The client ID of a public MCP client in your Falcon console, created with the redirect URI https://antigravity.google/oauth-callback. It must be in the same Falcon cloud as the server URL.
